# July 2025 Development Updates #3


[Reclaim Protocol](https://substack.com/@reclaimprotocol)


Jul 23, 2025


Hey devs, we're back with another fresh batch of updates across the Reclaim stack.


**Big Release Alert! v0.10.11 (Updated) is Here! 🚀**
We’ve been burning the midnight oil and we’re thrilled to roll out a massive upgrade to our mobile SDK ecosystem!


This release is all about


**resilience, speed, and smoother UX** . From better memory performance on low-end devices to smarter network handling and broader site compatibility - your users will feel the difference, and you’ll see the impact in reliability and speed.


## **Technical Details & Implementation**


### **Mobile SDK Ecosystem v0.10.11**


*SDKs Repositories: [React Native](https://github.com/reclaimprotocol/reclaim-inapp-reactnative-sdk) | [Android](https://github.com/reclaimprotocol/reclaim-inapp-android-sdk) | [iOS](https://github.com/reclaimprotocol/reclaim-inapp-ios-sdk)*


Super excited to share, We’ve just rolled out v0.10.11 of our mobile SDKs. Here’s what’s new and exciting for developers


See our new build release in action -


-


**Memory Optimization on Low-End Devices :** We’ve significantly improved how the SDK handles memory, especially on low-spec Android and iOS devices. This makes claim generation more stable and less likely to crash in memory-constrained environments.


-


**Resilient Claim Creation on weak Networks:** The new build now handles poor or unstable network connections much more gracefully. Claim generation and proof submission flows are now more fault-tolerant, improving success rates under real-world connectivity issues.


-


**Timeout Detection and User Feedback:** A new timeout mechanism detects inactivity during proof generation. If no user verification activity is observed within a specific window, app shows a descriptive error screen instead of stalling indefinitely.


-


**Broader Website Compatibility via Enhanced Interception:** Internal request interception logic has been upgraded to improve support across more third-party websites. This lays the groundwork for smoother data provider integrations and fewer blocks due to web environment constraints.


-


**Faster Login Event Detection:** Login detection has been optimized, leading to quicker transitions after authentication. This reduces time spent on the "Getting ready..." screen and improves overall verification flow responsiveness.


**Please update to version**` 0.10.11` This release focuses on stability, compatibility, and a smoother experience across devices and networks.


### **JavaScript SDK v4.3.1**


*Repository: [reclaim-js-sdk](https://github.com/reclaimprotocol/reclaim-js-sdk)*


**Bug Fix:**


*Prevent App Clip URL on Desktop Devices -*


[PR](https://github.com/reclaimprotocol/reclaim-js-sdk/pull/41)


Fixed an issue where the App Clip URL logic was being applied even on desktop devices, leading to unnecessarily long or malformed URLs. The code now checks the


**device type** and ensures that


**App Clip URLs are only generated on mobile devices** , as intended.


```text
//Before
if (this.options?.useAppClip) { let template = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(templateData)); template = replaceAll(template, '(', '%28'); template = replaceAll(template, ')', '%29');


//After
const deviceType = getDeviceType();
if (this.options?.useAppClip && deviceType === DeviceType.MOBILE) {
let template = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(templateData));
template = replaceAll(template, '(', '%28');
template = replaceAll(template, ')', '%29');


```


**Impact: -**


-


Desktop users will now receive shortened URLs without app clip metadata.


-


Prevents invalid behavior and unnecessary URL encoding on non-mobile devices.
